name: Alex. Morton
role: South Heart man who bought Dan McKenzie's blacksmith shop
bio: Alex. Morton of South Heart, brother of a Dr. Morton, offered property for sale at South Heart in July 1886. In October 1886 he bought Dan McKenzie's blacksmith shop and other Medora property, moved his family to town and began enlarging his cottage.

moments.label: Bought Dan McKenzie's blacksmith shop and property

mentions: Alex. Morton of South Heart, brother of Dr. Morton, was in town Tuesday.
…heifer.  Also a span of horses, wagon and harness. Will sell at a bargain at my place at South Heart.  Alex. Morton.

…an. McKenzie yesterday completed the sale of his blacksmith shop and the rest of his Medora property to Alex. Morton. As soon as Dan. gets the rest of his business straightened up, he will start for his Nova Scotia home, where he intends going into the livery business. We regret exceed…
Alex. Morton has brought his family to Medora and they are now keeping house in the building purchased from Dan. McKenzie. They will be a welcome addition to Medora.
Alex. Morton is building an addition to his cottage and making other improvements for winter.
